This solution contains:
- KeyValueStore: Storage abstraction for Azure Blob, Windows File System, AWS S3
- MitreAttackData: Fetching, parsing, and querying MITRE ATT&CK data
- OpenAIAgent: Agent logic, prompt handling, and OpenAI integration
- Tests: Unit and integration tests for all components

Focus on modular, testable code. Use async/await for I/O. Prefer dependency injection for extensibility. Use clear interfaces for storage and data access.
